name: 条件と複数処理・実行確認を縦につなぐ自動化の図
prompt: Create ONE Japanese automation workflow diagram LH09-0159 faithful to original Airtable crop554x583. White neutral canvas and four white rectangular rounded node cards, thin pale-gray borders, restrained tiny shadows. Compact nearly-square portrait layout. Narrow left rail aligned with four circular outlined TEST/PLAY triangle buttons and fine vertical gray connectors. Above first rail segment small gray『きっかけ』; between first and second node small gray『処理』section label; both present. Four nodes in order: 1 blue branching-condition glyph (diamond on top of blue elbow connector leading to three tiny horizontal gray/blue rectangles), title『条件に一致したとき』 and gray subtitle『状態が「確認中」または「完了」』. 2 filled GREEN pencil on very pale green SMALL icon tile, title『記録を更新』subtitle『状態』. 3 filled ORANGE magnifyingglass on tiny pale peach tile, title『記録を検索』subtitle『担当の作業が次のいずれかに一致：Air…』. Keep Air… intentionally truncated; do not invent hidden text. 4 filled BLUE envelope on pale blue SMALLtile, title『メールを送信』, NO subtitle. Node1 icon has white background; each title/subtitle right of icon. Footer below fourth node aligned to node left/right is DASHED gray outline add-area with plus and forest-green#174C36 text『高度な条件や処理を追加』. Original action semantic colors blue/green/orange/blue MUST remain; mock replaced all with green generic outlines and omitted処理label. Fine Regular Meiryo14/24 body, titles compact modest bold, gray12/16 subtitles, zero tracking. Preserve original four play controls, rail gaps, card sizes and spacing; no extra statuses, no global chrome, no invented data. Rastercandidate only.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
